d: Jet black hair, long and flowing with straight bangs and a center part. Pale pink, almond-shaped eyes with a calm, slight smile. Appears as a young adult with refined features. Slender build, wearing a white and crimson traditional-inspired outfit featuring a high collar, a wide black obi with a gold buckle, and voluminous white sleeves. Accessories include a golden zig-zag crown, a golden crescent-shaped headpiece, and a chunky black and gold necklace with a small blue gem.
